title: D5 Render workflows and connector status

D5

D5 Render

D5 Render provides real-time rendering and scene presentation for architectural design.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Synchronise a building model

Begin with the selected model, asset hierarchy and scale. In the intended D5 Render preview, synchronise a building model; the visible result is a composed scene with geometry and camera framing visible. Review object identity, silhouette and missing assets before accepting or exporting it.

Develop lighting and entourage

Use the approved scene state, materials and motion intent. In the intended D5 Render preview, develop lighting and entourage; the visible result is a lighting, animation or effects preview with changed controls exposed. Review timing, material response, collisions and visual continuity before accepting or exporting it.

Export a presentation sequence

Start from the reviewed cameras, render settings and delivery format. In the intended D5 Render preview, export a presentation sequence; the visible result is a bounded presentation sequence or image comparison. Review frame content, colour, legibility and output specification before accepting or exporting it.
